design_description: A high-energy white kit built around sharp lime-green and black graphics. The main pattern uses aggressive, fragmented diagonal streaks that cut across the shirt, creating a fast, almost electric visual language. On the front, the graphic is deliberately asymmetric: a smaller burst drops from the left shoulder, while the dominant lime-and-black composition rises diagonally from the lower right. This leaves a large clean white central area for the main branding and crest without making the jersey feel overcrowded. The back follows the same language but stays functional for player identification. The oversized lime number with a strong black outline becomes the focal point, while the graphic is pushed toward the shoulder and lower-right hem. Black typography provides strong contrast against the white base. Overall, it is a clean but aggressive three-colour design, white, lime and black, combining generous negative space with angular speed graphics. The asymmetry gives it movement while keeping the front and back visually connected.
